title: HubSpot–NetSuite Sync for Nutrition Brands Selling to Practitioners and Retailers
summary: Link HubSpot practitioner contacts and clinic companies to the approved NetSuite payer so two clinics, one distributor and one contact stay separate.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Connect practitioner and retailer relationships to the correct NetSuite payer without treating every professional contact as a separate wholesale customer. HubSpot can own outreach and sample follow-up, while finance approves the legal account and terms. A deliberate contact-to-clinic-to-payer model prevents duplicate accounts and misplaced order history.


Explore the complete[nutrition and supplements integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/nutrition-supplements) for the systems and processes around this guide.
